summary: Intermittent hanging streaming responses tied to Typescript SDK default timeout
description:
Issue summary: Customer using redwood-sdk-typescript reports streaming requests sometimes appear to hang. In their logs, the HTTP request remains open but no additional chunks arrive; they eventually abort.

Impact: User experience degraded; they time out at 30s and treat as failure.

Environment: Hosted API, OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions, Node 18, fetch-based client.

Notes: They are on a mobile carrier NAT sometimes; they suspect network flakiness.
comments: Naomi Feldman (Support): Customer description: 'stream just stalls' (no error). They abort after 30s. Any known issue?
Jasmine Liu (SDK): Our TS SDK sets a default request timeout but doesn't reset it on streamed bytes. For SSE, this makes long responses look like a hang.
Ethan Park (Platform): Heartbeat should keep the connection active, but client-side overall timeout still applies.
Jasmine Liu (SDK): Shipped SDK patch: disable overall timeout for stream by default; expose `streamTimeoutMs`.
Naomi Feldman (Support): Customer confirmed fix after upgrading to redwood-sdk-typescript 0.8.4.
resolution: Resolved by updating redwood-sdk-typescript to avoid treating long SSE streams as hung connections; customer upgraded.
